title: Membership | SC Freiburg
content: The club isn’t just about a passion for professional football; our youth teams in the Freiburg Football School are known nationally and we also aim to make an impact with our societal engagement. * The annual membership fee rises to 40 Euros from the age of 25. We are delighted at your interest in becoming an SC Freiburg member. You can fill out the online membership application here (Application form only available in GERMAN). Parents can also fill out an application for children and teenagers under the age of 18 (Application form only available in GERMAN). If you have any further questions about membership or you are unable to complete a form in German, we will of course be happy to help. For that reason, please be aware that memberships taken out after 1st May will only begin on 1st July, saving new members from paying the full yearly fee at the end of the season.
